import json, pathlib
replies = [
  {'id': f'T{i:02d}', 'status': 'closed', 'reason': 'Injected get_recipe log entries and kept usage per recipe.'} for i in range(1,35)
]
reasons = {
 'T47': ('Closed', 'Added goneMessage state showing This dashboard is no longer available on update/delete error; AppHeader hides Create when list empty and not loading.'),
 'T48': ('Closed', 'Added widgetGoneIds tracking via useEffect comparing previous and current widget ids, showing This widget is gone. status.'),
 'T62': ('Closed', 'Removed useWidgetStore import; DeleteDashboardDialog now calls deleteWidgetsByDashboard entity operation.'),
 'T63': ('Closed', 'Split page into DashboardHeader, NoteWidget, CounterWidget, ChecklistWidget, LinkListWidget and dialogs.'),
 'T64': ('Closed', 'Fixed import order to shared->entities->components->blocks->routes via lint --fix.'),
 'T65': ('Closed', 'Duplicate now tracks created widget ids and rolls back dashboard and widgets on failure.'),
 'T66': ('Closed', 'Create and duplicate now rollback partial records on failure with cleanup.'),
 'T67': ('Closed', 'Added wTitleSaving pending guard with loadingWithReason on widget title save.'),
}
for r in replies:
    if r['id'] in reasons:
        s, msg = reasons[r['id']]
        r['status'] = s.lower()
        r['reason'] = msg
for k in ['T47','T48','T62','T63','T64','T65','T66','T67']:
    if k not in [x['id'] for x in replies]:
        s,msg=reasons[k]
        replies.append({'id':k,'status':s.lower(),'reason':msg})
replies.sort(key=lambda x: int(x['id'][1:]))
open('/app/.weave/replies.json','w').write(json.dumps(replies,indent=2))
